It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.042 (vs ₹0.05 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.042 (up from ₹0.05 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹25.3m (up 9.6% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹2.24m (up ₹5.16m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 8.9% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). The move to profitability was primarily driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 26% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 7% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.
